purpose: attests the outcome vintage the in-flight capability rows were computed on. The ledger schema at launch carried no outcome_source_digest, so a resume could not have told two data vintages apart. This file supplies that missing attestation for the rows already written; every row written after the patch carries the digest inline.
untouched_by_nightly: the nightly update writes the DuckDB stores; this derived sidecar predates it by two days and was not rewritten
